domainemailsection.a_fresh_dkim_keypair_is_generated_and_th: A fresh DKIM keypair is generated and the DNS TXT record changes. Remote receivers may need propagation time before they accept the new signature; the old key is kept as a backup.

Two DNS records (TXT + A) appear and the agent serves the policy at https://mta-sts.<domain>/.well-known/mta-sts.txt. Cert renewal handles the SAN; no manual steps.

domainmailtlssection.clears_backoff_and_dispatches_ssl_mail_i: Clears backoff and dispatches ssl.mail.issue on the next reconciler tick

domainmailboxessection.a_send_only_mailbox_authenticates_for_sm: A send-only mailbox authenticates for SMTP submission but never receives or stores mail — inbound is rejected. Useful for per-service notification credentials.
domainmailboxessection.email_isn_t_enabled_on_this_domain: Email isn't enabled on this domain
domainmailboxessection.leave_blank_to_auto_generate_generated_p: Leave blank to auto-generate. Generated passwords are shown exactly once.

domainsslsection.paste_the_full_chain_certificate_leaf_in: Paste the full-chain certificate (leaf + intermediates) and the matching private key in PEM format. The key is stored on the server and never shown again.

maildeliverabilitypage.each_of_the_four_signals_can_subtract_up: Each of the four signals can subtract up to 25 points from a clean 100. The signals come from M47: RBL listings of the public IP, DKIM-failing buckets in inbound DMARC RUA reports, TLS-session failures in TLS-RPT reports, and abuse-feedback (ARF) reports from receiver postmasters. All counted over the last 7 days.

mailthrottlespage.each_row_converges_into_a_stalwart_mtaou: Each row converges into a Stalwart MtaOutboundThrottle object on the next reconciler tick. 0 = unlimited. v1 enforces the hourly cap (Stalwart's rate object takes one window); daily cap is logged but not enforced until a later wave splits it into a paired object.

adminsecurityapparmor.complain_mode_profiles_are_logging_would: Complain-mode profiles are logging would-deny (apparmor ALLOWED) violations — not soak-ready to enforce. Resolve or allowlist these before flipping to enforce.
adminsecurityapparmor.enforce_will_start_denying_paths_caps_no: Enforce will start denying paths/caps not in the profile.

adminsecuritycrowdsec.aggregates_every_active_decision_by_orig: Aggregates every active decision by (origin/scenario). CAPI = pulled from app.crowdsec.net; cscli-import = manually imported; crowdsec = local detection. Subscribe to community blocklists at app.crowdsec.net → Blocklists.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.allow_list_with_no_countries_blocks_ever: Allow-list with no countries blocks every request — add at least one before applying.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.allowlisted_ips_bypass_every_scenario_de: Allowlisted IPs bypass every scenario, decision, and the AppSec geoblock. Use for your office, home IP, or CI runner CIDR.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.behaviour_based_intrusion_prevention_tai: Behaviour-based intrusion-prevention. Tails server logs (nginx, sshd, panel, mail), matches them against scenarios (brute-force, scanners, web exploits, credential stuffing), and emits IP decisions. Bouncers enforce them at the firewall (UFW), at nginx (AppSec WAF with OWASP CRS rules + optional captcha challenge), and against a crowdsourced blocklist of IPs flagged by the wider community in the last hours.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.captcha_action_requires_the_captcha_reme: Captcha action requires the Captcha remediation card above to be enabled.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_bans_rely_on_the_geoip_enricher_: Country bans rely on the GeoIP enricher; AS bans on the ASN enricher. Both are installed by default on fresh CrowdSec hosts.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_exemption_applied: Country exemption updated — CIDR sync running in the background
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_exemption_apply_hint: {{count}} countries will never be blocked. CIDR sets sync in the background — large countries can take a few minutes.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_exemption_description: Countries whose traffic is never blocked by CrowdSec — no scenario bans, AppSec blocks, community blocklists or captchas. Complementary to the IP allowlist above. Wins over the Block Country deny-list.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_exemption_geoblock_overlap: {{countries}} is also in the Block Country deny-list — the exemption wins, so they will NOT be blocked. Remove them there to avoid confusion.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.country_exemption_sync_started: CIDR re-sync started in the background
adminsecuritycrowdsec.create_an_hcaptcha_recaptcha_turnstile_s: Create an hCaptcha / reCAPTCHA / Turnstile site at the provider, paste the keys below. Secret is stored server-side and never returned.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.deny_list_with_no_countries_has_no_effec: Deny-list with no countries has no effect — add at least one before applying.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.extra_cidrs_hint: One per line (IPs or CIDRs, v4 + v6). Always allowed, from any CrowdSec decision source — use for stragglers a country's zone data misses or known-good hosts abroad.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.leave_blank_to_keep_the_stored_secret_un: Leave blank to keep the stored secret unchanged.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.lines_no_parser_matched_gaps_in_coverage: Lines no parser matched (gaps in coverage)
adminsecuritycrowdsec.one_click_install_of_upstream_crowdsec_h: One-click install of upstream CrowdSec Hub items
adminsecuritycrowdsec.single_ipv4_ipv6_address_or_cidr_block_e: Single IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR block (e.g. 192.0.2.1 or 10.0.0.0/24).
adminsecuritycrowdsec.this_ip_was_banned_because_the_scenario_: This IP was banned because the scenario above fired on its traffic. Enforcement is applied by the active bouncers: the firewall bouncer drops it at nftables (all ports), and the nginx bouncer returns 403 on HTTP. To lift it, delete the decision (or add the IP to the Allowlist so it is never re-banned).
adminsecuritycrowdsec.this_is_a_broad_crowdsec_exemption_a_suc: This is a broad CrowdSec exemption. A successful login from a stolen key or compromised account shields that source IP from all CrowdSec decisions for the TTL. Lower the TTL or disable this if that window is unacceptable for your threat model.
adminsecuritycrowdsec.type_a_country_name_or_code_or_pick_from: Type a country name or code, or pick from the list
adminsecuritycrowdsec.when_enabled_crowdsec_scenarios_flagged_: When enabled, CrowdSec scenarios flagged for captcha serve a challenge page instead of a 403.

adminsecuritymalware.upload_fails_with_the_parser_error_if_th: Upload fails with the parser error if the rule is malformed. Filenames must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}\\.yar$ and are capped at 64 KB.

adminsecurityufw.enabling_ufw_will_activate_default_deny_: Enabling UFW will activate default-deny incoming. Make sure SSH (22) is in the allow-list.

adminsecurityufw.ufw_is_not_active_rules_below_if_any_are: UFW is not active. Rules below (if any) are not enforced. CrowdSec firewall-bouncer also has no effect until UFW is enabled.

domaincachesection.caches_php_html_responses_for_the_ttl_ab: Caches PHP/HTML responses for the TTL above (default 600s). On expiry the stale page is served instantly while nginx refreshes it in the background — no visitor waits for the rebuild. Automatically bypassed for POST requests, logged-in WordPress users, carts/checkout, wp-admin and session cookies, so dynamic and authenticated pages stay correct.

This does NOT cache JetEngine AJAX filters — those are admin-ajax POST requests and always bypass. Keep the list tight: faceted params multiply cache entries. Names are lower-case letters, digits, and underscores.
